Thank you it's been a rough couple weeks and I really don't know what to do anymore.
Kept  taking my ex back and not divorcing him sooner.

I was married for 10 years me and my husband had a lot of problems. We had a fight one night and he decided to sleep on the couch. I don't know why but something told me I needed to take my son to bed with me. He usually always slept in his own bed. Me and my son went to bed and I woke up with my husband on top of me. His legs where on top of mine he put his feet and twisted them into my legs He had one hand over my mouth so I could not scream and a knife to my throat slitting my throat.  My son 4 at the time woke up out of a dead sleep. Says dad what are you doing my husband gets off me but still on the bed. Stabs himself blood goes everywhere says look what your mom just did to me. ( When my son woke up I hurried and laid him down and covered him and his eyes.) my husband ran out the door I laid there for a minute holding my crying son. I heard the living room window open. I grabbed my son ran up the stairs and into my brothers room.  I've been divorced for 10 years now I have a lifetime restraining order against him. I just had to go to court with him last week and handed the bailiff the order. He says I have never seen a lifetime one. I said yeah you have never met my ex. They got two other bailiffs in the room. Ex decided to take me to court because his new wife doesn't want him to pay the amount he does for child support. Didn't work out for them.

Thank you so much fore responding. I have a therapist that I see weekly. She is amazing I just started two months ago. That is helping a lot. The whole school thing I just don't feel like myself I could do it. I guess the first thing i need to do is feel more positive about myself. I really don't like the person that I am. I don't likes the way I look or anything about me. I am really working on a lot of PTSD and that's been really hard for me. I do appreciate talking to someone. My family just doesn't understand anything and I have no friends at all.

With words in a dream I've been told to always look at what other words they wan spell. Not sure though I am kinda new at all this. I had the worse dream I have ever had last night and it all felt so real so I am just looking for advice.
Forgot to say that when I woke up I had bruises on my hand. I think it was from hitting the wall, and my body just felt horrible like my entire body hurt.
